sentences.text: South Australia’s Independent Commissioner Against Corruption began evaluating the Police Ombudsman’s procedures because of complaint delays and a parallel legislative review.
sentences.support:
First, I had noted the time taken to deal with complaints about police and the impact that internal 
processes might have had on those delays.

sentences.text: The Commissioner discontinued the evaluation after procedural changes and recommendations in the separate legislative review reduced its usefulness.
sentences.support:
In light of the recommendations in that review and in light of the procedural changes that have occurred 
in the Police Ombudsman’s office

sentences.text: The Commissioner concluded that remaining complexity in the police complaints system required legislative amendment.
sentences.support:
Many of the systems for the resolution of complaints and reports about police remain complex and 
unwieldy.

findings.quote:
Many of the systems for the resolution of complaints and reports about police remain complex and 
unwieldy.

notes: This short report explains a discontinued evaluation and has no separate summary. Legislative recommendations belong to a separate report; procedural changes attributed to the Acting Police Ombudsman are not presented as findings of this evaluation. PDF page 2 is blank.
